```{r setup, include=FALSE}
  echo = FALSE,
```

```{r captions, include=FALSE}
# Find all figure files
files <- list.files(path = ".",
  pattern = "^FigS[0-9]+.*\\.png$",
  full.names = TRUE,
)

# Sort numerically
fig_num <- as.integer(sub(".*FigS([0-9]+).*", "\\1", basename(files)))
files <- files[order(fig_num)]
fig_num <- sort(fig_num)


captions <- data.frame(
```

```{r results='asis', echo=FALSE}

for(i in seq_along(files)) {

  n <- fig_num[i]

  ## Figure
  cat(sprintf("![](%s){width=100%%}\n\n", files[i]))

  ## Caption
  cap <- captions$caption[captions$fig_num == n]

  cat(sprintf("**Figure S%d.** %s\n\n", n, cap))

  ## New page
  cat("\\newpage\n\n")
}
```
